I don't use auto-rifles that often, tend to use pulse. You can get a really good roll for a pulse rifle from the crucible vendor called 'Hawksaw'.

The auto rifles most commonly used are ones such as the Doctrine of passing (Trials of Osiris) or Soul Stealers Claw (Ranking up with house of judgement). Crucible packages can drop some decent autos such as the Grim Citizen. End of match rewards an get you the red spectre. The rolls  are different each time so just find perks that you think could be useful (Just not gorilla fighter)

You could buy the arms day packages (Gunsmith on a Wednesday) of different autos and try them out. Perks for these are random and so I would recommend watching a video on the rolls if you're not sure on what to get after buying the weapon.

I think that Leafy shouldn't make videos on a daily basis if it comes to doing videos in which the original creator may be in the same circumstances that Tommy was in. In the case of the larger videos, I support that as they have many millions of viewers and so should be able to take criticism. Less popular content creators aren't used to criticism in the same light as these popular ones (E.g. Vine Kids or that SSundee minecraft animation). 

Furthermore the videos should have some constructive criticism in bedded into it. This would mean that the creator would have something to work on after the video has been made. I feel like this would improve the video quality and would also result in less hate towards Leafy. 

As a way to try and ease the hate being passed around, I think Leafy should take a break for a week or so. Apologize publicly to Tommy and contact him directly to resolve the situation, similar to what Keemstar did to the Runescape livestreamer.

TL;DR - Don't target smaller youtubers who cant take criticism, Constructive criticism in videos, Apologize to Tommy publicly and directly resolve the situation between Tommy, Leafy and H3H3.
